title: Jimmie Noone and Sweet Lorraine
summary: He remembers Noone as a gentle man devoted to his wife and links this to Sweet Lorraine.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: That's what I understand. Are there any of the other New Orleans musicians? I keep sort of bringing you back to that. I'm not trying to make you talk about only them, but I wondered any other fellows that you could talk about from New Orleans or do you remember the other musicians that you might have worked with?
Well, I think that Jimmy Noon was a great musician. I think, if I make no mistake, I think he wrote Sweet Lorraine.
That was his theme song anyway, I'm sure.

Sweet Lorraine is one of the great romantic stories, love stories. And I knew Jimmy Noonan. And I know he loved his wife. I think his wife's name was Lorraine. Sweet Lorraine. And every time I hear that number, I think of Jimmy Noonan.

Never did anything to hate the feelings of anyone. And he was with Lorraine, Sweet Lorraine when he passed. And I look upon Sweet Lorraine as one of the great classics. But every time I hear it, it touches me. Because I knew how he loved, loved his wife, how devoted he was. I never even knew of Jimmy, even smiling at another female. He was that devoted. And if you just listen to the words of Sweet Lorraine, you can almost feel it yourself.
